Lightweight Aluminium Frame

The high quality aluminum frame provides a lightweight but stable riding experience and makes it easier to handle on roads and bike paths.

Efficient 7 Speed Shifting

Precise 7-speed shifting allows effortless shifting and provides optimal speed for city driving or longer commuting distances.

Double Disc Brakes

Mechanical front and rear disc brakes ensure reliable and powerful braking performance, even in wet or slippery road conditions.

Two frame heights available:

choose between 530 mm and 570 mm frame height for a perfect fit and maximum riding comfort. Ideal for different body sizes.

Ideal for Everyday Coute

The Hiland 700C road bike combines speed and comfort, perfect for commuting, training sessions or relaxing weekend tours.

Experience the perfect blend of speed and comfort with the Hiland Clifford 2 Hybrid Bike. Features a lightweight aluminum frame, 7-speed drivetrain, and 700C wheels for a smooth commute. Shop now!

【It's time to try Clifford!】
Clifford is a flat handlebar hybrid bike from Hiland, especially for beginners. Its minimalist style, affordable price and high-quality components contribute to its popularity among consumers, and it has become a hot seller. Hiland hybrid bikes combine the features of road and mountain bikes, so they are not only adaptable to a variety of terrain conditions such as mountains, forests and highways, but also suitable for daily occasions such as fitness, commuting and casual cycling. If you're still on the fence about the type of bike you want, a hybrid bike is a smart choice. Start your road trip with the Clifford!
